subject: Fix 12 pre-existing failing test suites (claim-gate contract drift + teardown)
description:
The full suite is 124/136 on main (HEAD 2ea15cb). 12 files fail — VERIFIED pre-existing (fail identically at clean base 9737a0d, predate the ask-gate/loop work). Fix them so the suite goes green.

ROOT CAUSE (already diagnosed): the DG1/DG2 claim gate (start_task now requires session_id and refuses dispatcher/unregistered claims; see context tasks 091a4bf1/20, local/dg1, local/dg2, local/b3) changed the claim contract. These suites still issue claims the OLD way, so claims get refused or return a different 409 reason and assertions written against the pre-gate contract miss. A few others are daemon-lifecycle/port-teardown infra (assertions pass but the file fails at suite level — e.g. touch-agent passes all 20 sub-assertions yet the file is marked failed).

THE 12 FILES:
- Claim-gate contract drift: test/unwired-quarantine.test.js, test/endpoints.test.js, test/force-claim-cap.test.js, test/metric-branch-claim.test.js, test/newly-ready.test.js, test/phase2-integration.test.js, test/dispatcher-model.test.js, test/judge-journal.test.js
- Infra/teardown: test/touch-agent.test.js, test/app-restart.test.js, test/filedrop-daemon.test.js, test/should-stop-advisory.test.js

APPROACH (run-test-fix loop, fix the TESTS not the product — the gate behavior is intentional and correct):
1. For each claim-gate file: read what it asserts, then update fixtures to the new contract — pass session_id on start_task / register a worktree (branch_task) before claiming, and update expected 409 reasons/messages to the current gate semantics. Do NOT weaken the product gate to satisfy a test.
2. For infra/teardown files: find why the file fails despite passing assertions — almost certainly port collision or daemon not torn down / unhandled async after the last test. Fix the teardown (await daemon close, unique port per file) so the file exits clean.
3. Re-run each fixed file to green, then run the FULL suite (node scripts/run-tests.js) and confirm 136/136 (or document any that are genuinely out of scope with reasons — no silent skips).
Surgical: touch only test files + test helpers/fixtures. If a fix would require changing product code, STOP and report it as a finding (it would mean the gate has a real bug, contradicting the diagnosis).

summary:
Suite green: 124/136 -> 136/136 (node scripts/run-tests.js). Fixed 12 test files (test-only; NO product code touched). Two product contract shifts the fixtures lagged behind:

(1) DG1/DG2 claim gate — POST /overlay/status in_progress now needs session_id (400 if not inferable) + a registered worktree (claim-side security boundary; dispatcher/unregistered claims 409), and metric-spec tasks need the claim workspace on an orch/attempt/* branch. Per file:
 - touch-agent: dropped the /git/worktree from the dispatcher-rejection case (a worktree-backed claim self-registers and is ALLOWED; the negative case must be worktree-less to stay 409).
 - unwired-quarantine, endpoints, force-claim-cap, metric-branch-claim, newly-ready, phase2-integration, dispatcher-model, filedrop-daemon, should-stop-advisory, app-restart: git-init the workspace, register a worktree per claimed key (/git/worktree or MCP branch_task), supply session_id, kept negative dispatcher/unwired cases worktree-less. metric-branch: good claim runs from the daemon-created attempt worktree (branch is orch/attempt/*) with metric+root mirrored into that worktree's overlay.
 - FINDING (test-logic, not product): unwired-quarantine and filedrop-daemon each used a task as the 'unwired' example that a dependent's native blockedBy edge actually wires (overlay.addEdge clears unwired on BOTH endpoints) — so those tasks were never unwired even at clean base. Repointed each to a dedicated standalone fixture (K(5) blocker / cursor/ccc).

(2) Shadow-classifier contract (commit 4f4e446): judge.appendVerdict no longer passes through explicit shadow_verdict/shadow_conf/model_version — it SHADOW-RUNS the learned edge classifier (scripts/edge-clf-predict), stamping the classifier verdict/conf + model_version:'v1-provisional' on every edge row when a classifier is loadable, none otherwise. Rewrote judge-journal v2 blocks to assert the classifier-driven contract (present-as-a-set), gated on classifier availability so they hold in bot
